Subject: MAP Draft: Ava Solutions — Post-call recap

Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this afternoon. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short SOC 2 summary for your security team to review. Below is a concise, actionable recap with draft owners and target dates. This is intended to be collaborative — please flag changes.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Milestone 1 — Executive approval (economic decision)
  - Target: 2027-04-15
  - Owner: Michael Ross (CFO) — please confirm
  - RACI (draft): A
- Milestone 2 — Security review & questionnaire completion
  - Target: 2027-04-29
  - Owner: Lena Ortiz (Security) — please confirm
  - RACI: C
- Milestone 3 — Procurement / PO issuance
  - Target: 2027-05-10
  - Owner: procurement@avasolutions.com
  - RACI: R
- Milestone 4 — Pilot deployment (eng validation)
  - Target: 2027-05-24
  - Owner: Eng lead (please nominate)
  - RACI: R
- Milestone 5 — Production launch / handoff
  - Target close date: 2027-05-31
  - Owner: Product / Eng

Dependencies:
- Confirmation of SOC 2 gaps and required compensating controls (security team)
- Procurement PO processing timelines
- Availability of your engineering resources for pilot (+2–4 weeks)

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, and engineering lead for the MAP.
2) Review attached MAP draft and leave inline comments; I'll produce v2 and circulate.
3) If this looks reasonable, can we lock a 30-min alignment call on Thu, Mar 18 to finalize dates?

Attachments (stubs): 20270315-AvaSolutions-MAP-Draft.xlsx (MAP draft) — spreadsheet with milestones/RACI
Attachments (stubs): SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level SOC 2 status)

Thanks,

We've penciled the follow-up call for Mar 18 — I can do 11:00am ET. If you want Marissa or an engineer from Redwood on the call, please include them.

Sara — thanks for the quick confirmation and the RACI list. Helpful.

Responses / updates
- SOC 2 scope: attaching the SOC2-summary.pdf we shared; short answer — our SOC 2 Type II covers production inference and access controls for the model infra. The specific PII flow you described (hashed values) is an integration pattern we've validated with similar customers. That said, Lena's review is welcome — please have her flag any gaps and we'll escalate any compensating controls.
- Procurement timing: noted. I've shifted the MAP draft to include a 2-week procurement window (PO processing) before pilot start. Updated target close date (production launch) moved to 2027-05-27 to account for that buffer.

Attached: updated MAP draft (same filename, v2).

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call on Thu, Mar 18 at 11:00am ET — I'll include Marissa (CS lead) and Dylan (solutions engineering) to run through security & pilot runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.
